pool.text: Yongzhou was besieged by Lý forces during the Lý–Song War.
Yongzhou was renamed Nanning Lu of Yongzhou in the Yuan dynasty.
Nanning was captured by the Communist Party on December fourth.
Nanning economy began developing beyond its former role with sustained industrial growth.
Nanning municipality was set up and identified as the capital city.
The Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region was established with Nanning municipality as capital.
Nanning served as host for the annual China–ASEAN Expo which began.
The city was the venue for the World Robotics Olympiad.
High-speed service was introduced on the Hunan–Guangxi railway and Beihai line.
The first was completed and put into operation in June.
The second began operation in December in Nanning.
Nanning North railway station is set to open with high-speed railway.
The registered population of the city reached over eight million people.
Nanning was ranked one of the top science cities globally.
